subject: Executive pre-demo handshake — propose evening slot and VP/CIO coverage
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@altanova.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Desai <samir.desai@altanova.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 21:05:00 +0000
Subject: Exec presence — demo next week (evening window)?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We have a small but critical ask from our leadership: Samir (CIO) and our VP of Platform would like to attend the demo live. Their calendars are tight; the only contiguous window that works is an evening slot (US PT 17:00–18:00 / ET 20:00–21:00) on either Wed 24th or Thu 25th.

Can Redwood run a condensed 30–40 minute exec-focused demo + Q&A in that window? Ideally: 20 minutes product walkthrough (high-level), 10–15 minutes targeted architecture questions (data plane, isolation), and 5–10 minutes on next steps / procurement timeline. I attached a very short agenda.

If an evening slot is a hard no, tell us who you can make available as a senior sponsor (VP/Director) to speak to architecture and procurement tradeoffs — Samir wants to meet someone senior from the product team. Also, we need a recording and a brief SOW draft afterwards.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Director of Platform
Altanova

Attachment: Altanova-demo-agenda.pdf

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@altanova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Exec presence — demo next week (evening window)?

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clarity and the agenda. We can absolutely accommodate an evening window for an exec-focused session. Quick proposals below (PT times):

Option A (preferred): Wed 24 Mar, 17:00–17:40 PT — Jonas to open and run high-level demo, Marissa to lead architecture Q&A, Naomi to join for procurement/next-steps.
Option B (backup): Thu 25 Mar, 17:30–18:10 PT — same staffing, shifted by 30 minutes.

If Samir wants an explicit pre-demo 10-minute touch with a senior product leader, Naomi can host a 10-minute pre-call at 16:40 PT (same day) so we’re aligned on sensitive procurement/security items. We will share a brief SOW draft right after the session (we have a working draft and can add Altanova-specific notes).

Logistics notes:
- We’ll send a calendar invite and a short runbook (who speaks when).
- Recording will be captured; we’ll redact internal debug logs.
- Prep: Marissa, can you grab the architecture slide (isolation + VPC routing + audit logs)? Naomi, can you have the procurement cadence and an initial commercial range prepared?

Ellen, which option works best for Samir (A or B)? If neither, tell me the single best evening date/time and we’ll try to accommodate.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0188

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform for production LLMs

Thanks — sending the calendar invite now.

- Runbook: I'll add speaker timestamps and the slide deck attachment placeholder (Altanova-demo-agenda.pdf).
